y-m-43-02.topic: Iimatrix ezimbini isiphumo sazo yimatrix yezero (AB=O)
y-m-43-02.goal: Vavanya ukuba ipropati esebenza kumanani inokuthwalelwa kwiimatrix njengoko injalo, yenza umzekelo apho AB=O kodwa akukho nanye kuA okanye B yimatrix yezero ucacise isizathu usebenzisa ipropati ye-A, uze ukhethe iimeko apho isigqibo sisebenza.
y-m-43-02.material: Imatrix ibhalwa umgca ngomgca, yaye oko kungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumgca wokuqala. Umzekelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] yimatrix apho umgca wokuqala ungu-1, 1 kwaye umgca wesibini ungu-0, 1. E yimatrix yoqobo [1 0 ; 0 1], kwaye O yimatrix yezero enamalungu onke angu-0. Kumanani, ukuba ab=0 ngoko a=0 okanye b=0. UYerin wathi, 'Iimatrix nazo zinemithetho yokudibanisa nokuphindaphinda, ngoko ukuba AB=O ngoko A=O okanye B=O.' Kulo msebenzi A=[1 2 ; 2 4] imisiwe, yaye A ayiyo imatrix yezero.

y-m-43-04.topic: Intsingiselo yesiphumo semetrix: imigca nemiqolo yetafile yobuninzi netafile yamaxabiso
y-m-43-04.goal: Hlula oko kunokubalwa xa iitafile ezimbini ziphindaphindwa noko kwenza isiphumo sibe nentsingiselo, tolika intsingiselo yamalungu esiphumo, uze ucacise ukuba ilungu elinye lokubala ngocwangciso olutshintshiselweyo libala ntoni.
y-m-43-04.material: Imatrix ibhalwa umgca ngomgca, yaye oko kungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumgca wokuqala. Umzekelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] yimatrix apho umgca wokuqala ungu-1, 1 kwaye umgca wesibini ungu-0, 1. E yimatrix yoqobo [1 0 ; 0 1], kwaye O yimatrix yezero enamalungu onke angu-0. Esikolweni, iKlasi 1 neKlasi 2 zithenga isonka nobisi njengesidlo esilula. Itafile yobuninzi N inemigca yeeklasi (umgca wokuqala iKlasi 1, umgca wesibini iKlasi 2) kunye nemiqolo yezinto (umqolo wokuqala isonka, umqolo wesibini ubisi): N=[3 2 ; 1 4]. (IKlasi 1 ithenga izonka ezi-3 nobisi olu-2, iKlasi 2 ithenga isonka esi-1 nobisi olu-4.) Itafile yamaxabiso P inemigca yezinto (umgca wokuqala isonka, umgca wesibini ubisi) kunye nemiqolo yeevenkile (umqolo wokuqala ivenkile X, umqolo wesibini ivenkile Y): P=[1500 1800 ; 1000 1200]. (Iyunithi yi-won. Kwivenkile X, isonka yi-1500 won kwaye ubisi yi-1000 won / kwivenkile Y, isonka yi-1800 won kwaye ubisi yi-1200 won.) Bafuna ukufumanisa iindleko zonke zeklasi nganye nevenkile nganye. UJiho wathi, 'Phindaphinda nje u-N no-P ngolu cwangciso,' yaye uSeoa wathi, 'Zombini zi-2×2, ngoko ukuphindaphinda u-P no-N nako kunokubalwa, ngoko ucwangciso alunamsebenzi.'

y-m-43-05.material: Imatrix ibhalwa umgca ngomgca, yaye oko kungaphambi kwe-semicolon (;) ngumgca wokuqala. y-m-43-06.goal: Vavanya isigqibo jikelele esithatha inqununu eyenzeke yasebenza njengobungqina bokuba ibambe, yenza iimatrikhsi apho ifomyula iphuka uze uhlole phantsi kwemeko enjani iphuka, uze ubhale ukuphikisa okusekelwe kwesi siphumo.
y-m-43-06.material: Imatrikhsi ibhalwa umqolo ngomqolo, kwaye oko kungaphambi kwesemikholoni (;) ngumqolo wokuqala. Umzekelo, [1 1 ; 0 1] yimatrikhsi enomqolo wokuqala 1, 1 nomqolo wesibini 0, 1. E yimatrikhsi yobuchule [1 0 ; 0 1], kwaye O yimatrikhsi yeziro enamalungu onke angu-0. I-determinant yematrikhsi ye-2×2 M=[a b ; c d] ibhalwa |M|=ad-bc. UDoyun uthe, 'I-determinant yesixa seematrikhsi ezimbini ilingana nesixa se-determinant zazo. Oko kukuthi, |A+B|=|A|+|B|.' Njengobungqina, uvavanye A=[1 0 ; 0 0] kunye no-B=[0 1 ; 1 0], kwaye |A+B|=|[1 1 ; 1 0]|=-1 kunye ne-|A|+|B|=0+(-1)=-1, ezazilingana.

Ukuba usebenzisa u-A kuqala emva koko B kwichaphazelo (1, 2), liba yi-(6, 2), yaye ukuba usebenzisa B kuqala emva koko A, liba yi-(4, 2). Iziphumo ziyahluka, ngoko indlela yokuhlehlisa ayinakufana. Amaxabiso echaphazelo ayafuneki ukumisela imatrix ehlehlisayo.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku uyazi ukuba 'A yenziwe kuqala emva koko B'. Yimatrix enjani enika ichaphazelo lokuqala xa iphindaphindwa kwichaphazelo eliphumileyo?
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ichaphazelo lokuqala (1, 2) laba yi-(6, 2) nge-A emva koko B. Sebenzisa umgqatswa ngamnye kule (6, 2) uze uhlole ukuba (1, 2) liyabuya.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.1: Xa isiphumo semetrix sisebenzisiwe kwichaphazelo, gqiba ukuba imatrix yasekunene okanye yasekhohlo isetyenziswa kuqala, uze uyidibanise nokuba yeyiphi imatrix eyayiyiguqulelo lokugqibela.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.a: Xa uphindaphinda isiphumo semetrix B^(-1)A^(-1) kwichaphazelo, esekunene, A^(-1), isetyenziswa kuqala. Thelekisa oku nocwangciso apho uhlehlisa uqala kutshintsho lokugqibela.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.b: Imatrix edibanisa ukuhlehlisa okubini ayihlehlisi ichaphazelo kabini kodwa idibanisa iziphumo ezimbini. Ukusebenzisa ngokulandelelana nokudibanisa kwahlukile.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.c: Imatrix eguqulelweyo ye-A+B ayiyiyo eguqulelweyo yokusebenzisa u-A no-B ngokulandelelana. Isixa sisebenzo esahlukileyo kwisenzo esinye emva kwesinye.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.explain: Ukuba ichaphazelo lihanjiswa ngu-A emva koko B, ichaphazelo eliphumileyo yi-B(A x) (ichaphazelo lokuqala x liphindaphindwa kuqala ngu-A emva koko eso siphumo siphindaphindwe ngu-B). Ukulihlehlisa, kufuneka uqale uhlehlise eyokugqibela eyenziwe, B (B^(-1)), emva koko uhlehlise u-A (A^(-1)). Xa uphindaphinda iimatrix, imatrix yasekunene isetyenziswa kuqala, ngoko yi-A^(-1)B^(-1). Umzekelo: xa ichaphazelo lokuqala (1, 2) laba yi-(6, 2), B^(-1) inika (3, 2) yaye A^(-1) ibuyisa (1, 2).
y-m-43-03.s.s3.prompt: Ingaba likho ichaphazelo apho isiphumo sifana nokuba ucwangciso luyiphi? Fumana ufake amachaphazelo amabini ahlukeneyo anamanani aphelele (x, y), angeyo-origin, apho 'isiphumo sokwenza u-A kuqala emva koko B' 'nesiphumo sokwenza u-B kuqala emva koko A' sifana.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngokwa-x no-y ii-coordinates zechaphazelo elifunyenwe ngokusebenzisa u-A kuqala emva koko B kwichaphazelo (x, y). Bhala imeko apho B yenziwe kuqala ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xa ulinganisa ii-coordinates zokuqala zamachaphazelo amabini, jonga ukuba ubudlelwane obunjani phakathi kuka-x no-y busala.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Lichaphazelo elinee-coordinates ezingamanani aphelele yaye x ayingo-0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Nceda ulenze libe lichaphazelo elinee-coordinates ezingamanani aphelele kunye no-x ongengo-0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Iziphumo zeendlela ezimbini zifana. (I-coordinate yokuqala ifana, yaye i-coordinate yesibini ihlala ingu-y.)
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Iziphumo zeendlela ezimbini ziyahluka. Bhala isiphumo sika-A kuqala emva koko B nesika-B kuqala emva koko A nganye njenge-(x, y) uze uthelekise.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.explain: Ukuba wenza u-A kuqala emva koko B, (x, y) idlula kwi-(x+y, y) yaye iba yi-(2x+2y, y). Ukuba wenza u-B kuqala emva koko A, idlula kwi-(2x, y) yaye iba yi-(2x+y, y). Ukuze ii-coordinates zokuqala zilingane, 2y=y, oko kukuthi, y=0. Ngoko ucwangciso alunamsebenzi kuphela kumachaphazelo asekuhlatyeni lwe-x, yaye kwamanye amachaphazelo ucwangciso lutshintsha isiphumo.
